description:
Mark every notification as read

Marks every unread notification of this account as read in one statement and stamps each with the current server time. Entries that are already read are left untouched, so their original `readAt` is preserved. The call succeeds even when there is nothing unread, and it does not report how many rows it touched. This endpoint takes no request body.
name: mark_all_notifications_read
title: Mark every notification as read
